title: Dow Jones Futures Fall As Oil Prices Top $100; Nvidia Wavers, Walmart Falls, SpaceX Files For Huge IPO
title_zh: 油价突破 100 美元，道琼斯期货下跌；英伟达动摇、沃尔玛倒闭、SpaceX 申请大规模 IPO
summary: Futures fell as oil prices rebounded: Nvidia stock wavered after strong earning. Elon Musk's SpaceX released its IPO filing.
summary_zh: 随着油价反弹，期货下跌：英伟达股价在强劲盈利后出现波动。埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 公布了 IPO 文件。

title: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square to Raise $5 Billion from IPO
title_zh: 比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 的潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 将通过 IPO 筹集 50 亿美元
summary: Closely followed investor Bill Ackman looks likely to raise $5 billion from the upcoming initial public offering (IPO) of his investment ​management company Pershing Square.
summary_zh: 备受关注的投资者比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 看来可能会通过其投资管理公司潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 即将进行的首次公开募股 (IPO) 筹集 50 亿美元。

title: Inspire Brands Picks Banks For IPO That Could Raise $2 Billion
title_zh: Inspire Brands 选择银行进行 IPO 融资 20 亿美元
summary: Roark-backed restaurant group taps JPMorgan and Bank of America, with listing possibly coming as soon as this year
summary_zh: Roark支持的餐饮集团与摩根大通和美国银行合作，最早可能于今年上市

title: SpaceX IPO Set to Be a Catalyst for 2026 IPO Boom: ETFs to Gain
title_zh: SpaceX IPO 将成为 2026 年 IPO 热潮的催化剂：ETF 将获利
summary: SpaceX could be the catalyst for a surge as the U.S. IPO market eyes a comeback. ETFs like FPX, IPO and IPOS offer an easy way to gain exposure.
summary_zh: 随着美国 IPO 市场有望卷土重来，SpaceX 可能成为股价飙升的催化剂。 FPX、IPO 和 IPOS 等 ETF 提供了一种获得投资的简单方法。

title: SpaceX Eyes IPO as Market Conditions Grow More Uncertain. What the Charts Show.
title_zh: 随着市场状况变得更加不确定，SpaceX 考虑进行 IPO。图表显示什么。
summary: The prospect of a SpaceX IPO has become a key focal point for markets, and any delay tied to deteriorating conditions could carry broader implications.
summary_zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股的前景已成为市场的主要焦点，任何因情况恶化而导致的延误都可能带来更广泛的影响。
